reasons.derived_from_title_or_document: The old row came from a meeting title or a witness list PDF, which no native parser reads.
reasons.house_xml_witness_not_parsed: The event has House XML but native witnesses have no row for it; a family name in the raw XML is a lead, so this needs a parser check.
reasons.member_ineligible_split_see_ct-qg8e: Archive-member eligibility split, awaiting the ct-qg8e owner decision.
reasons.native_found_more: The native record states rows the old derived file lacks.
reasons.new_snapshot_only: The frozen captures end at the 2026-10-28 snapshot, after the retained old inputs.
reasons.no_public_url: The source states no URL, so a URL key cannot match.
reasons.not_a_row_fact: A condition, not a stored fact: it is derived by query from native tables.
reasons.old_state_only: Rows the old exporter built from state files with no native source yet; kept by old-release reference.
reasons.old_text_mojibake: The old CSV stored this text double-encoded; once repaired it equals the native value, which is the correct one.
reasons.old_uuid_diagnostic: A diagnostic about an old UUID row; the fact it concerns is carried natively, or by old-release reference.
reasons.other_source_meeting: An old meeting from a Senate page or House XML with no Congress.gov event ID.
reasons.pending_r2_matcher: Scored date and title matches arrive with the native decide() producer.
reasons.pending_r2_package_event_link: Raw MODS states the name, and native witnesses hold it on a package occasion with no event; the package-to-event link arrives with native hearing records.
reasons.pending_r2_print_link: Print-to-meeting links are derived; they arrive with native hearing records.
reasons.pending_r2_senate_page_link: Senate page-to-event links are held only in derived data until the derived-link layer.
reasons.release_delta_unexplained_see_ct-qg8e: Release delta on row counts owned by the ct-qg8e accounting.
reasons.superseded_by_newer_record: The key is in an older retained record of this event; the current record replaced it.
reasons.unexplained: No reason established. Reported, not hidden.
reasons.witness_name_normalization: The event matches but the name spelling differs; not proof of a different person.
